personas.name: The Startup Founder
personas.description: An ambitious early-stage founder who needs to launch an MVP quickly, validate the market, and impress investors — with limited budget and no in-house tech team.
problems: No technical co-founder or in-house engineering team
Needs to launch fast before running out of runway
Juggling multiple freelancers with inconsistent quality
goals: Look credible to investors and early users
painPoints: Fear of building the wrong thing

personas.name: The Small Business Owner
personas.description: A hands-on business owner who wants a professional online presence and simple automation to save time, without needing to understand the technology.
problems: Low online visibility and few inbound leads
goals: Get more leads and customers online
Look as professional as bigger competitors

personas.name: The Growth Lead
personas.description: A department lead at a growing company who needs to scale digital operations, ship new products and adopt automation to keep up with demand.
problems: Too much manual work across teams
goals: Introduce AI automation to boost efficiency
Ship new features and campaigns faster

personas.name: The Enterprise Decision Maker
personas.description: A senior executive responsible for large digital transformation initiatives who values reliability, security, compliance and a partner who can deliver at scale.
problems: Need for secure, compliant, scalable delivery
painPoints: High stakes and low risk tolerance
